design_notes.primary_ranking: H4 is decided on within-environment Spearman (does q flag which queries are uncertain). Across-environment Spearman (does q flag which environments are poorly adapted) is reported and decides nothing.
design_notes.baseline_rule: H4 is judged on whether P adds beyond ||phi||^2, whose ranks equal those of the prior variance.
design_notes.h10_primary: H10 cells are decided on prequential one-step RMSE in the normalized target space.
protocol_departures: H4 and H10 are decided on one-step error, as specified for them, not on rollout horizon 10.
No closed-loop control is measured in this thread.
design_notes.selection: Test tiers are never used for lambda, sigma^2, forgetting or surprise threshold.

scope_limit: Small state-based simulators on CPU; no claim about pixels, large models, or real robots.
